fusions.name: Rhizome Runner
fusions.desc: Sends a root runner along the ground that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. It then links on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Liana Haul
fusions.desc: Throws a thorned liana round a target up to 6 tiles away and hauls you to it, then deals 12 damage, leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds and slows it by 30% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Graft-Bound Stand
fusions.desc: Grafts your roots to every ally within 5 tiles: each one strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Links Underground
fusions.desc: Each time you inflict a condition on an enemy, linked roots wrap you in a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 18 seconds.
